text: Bitcoin has broken above $79k with a stronger 24h gain than Ethereum, consolidating its dominance at 59.1% while Ethereum trails at +2.7%, suggesting capital is favoring the largest asset. The Fear & Greed index sits in greed territory at 74 with a sharp 33-point weekly rise, reflecting a shift from fear to euphoria that has also lifted altcoins like Solana to outsized gains. The $127B in daily volume indicates broad participation, though the divergence between Bitcoin's outperformance and Ethereum's relative weakness hints at selective risk appetite rather than uniform conviction.
